edition.title: North Carolina Savannah river-basin classification schedule
edition.publisher: North Carolina Department of Environmental Quality
edition.scope: Complete 103 named Savannah schedule records, independently reconciled to the publisher Savannah-labelled native GIS cohort

special_markers.+: Downstream ORW protection management strategy under 15A NCAC 02B .0225; does not itself add ORW to a reach's literal class.
special_markers.@: Downstream HQW protection management strategy under 15A NCAC 02B .0201; does not itself add HQW to a reach's literal class.

source_notes.priority_predicate: Original class components contain Tr, HQW or ORW; a jurisdiction-specific screening field.
source_notes.county_policy: No county inferred: neither source schedule supplies county codes.
source_notes.geographic_scope: The publisher Savannah cohort must be intersected with the retained reporting domain and original217 HUC12 boundaries.
source_notes.association: Same-jurisdiction exact BIMS index and full class support candidate associations; reach coextensivity remains an explicit geometry determination.
